author: Hazyel
body: A while ago, I got banned for flying which I deeply regret. I want to get more interactive with the server and I want to explore it a lot more since my knowledge on this server is limited. I will be very grateful if it was at least lowered to a temporary ban. Thank you for your time.

title: Ban Appeal

replies.author: Zeusy
replies.body:
Hello,

After reviewing your appeal, I've decided to reduce your punishment to a 2 week tempban.

Thanks!
